Posted 'Hoth Echo Docking Bay' and 'Yavin IV Docking Bay' dested the Dark site pages; 'Insignificant Rebelion' dested the Death Star II Effect Insignificant Rebellion (not a (V) card); 'Your Destiny' dested the Death Star II Effect.

Posted 'Prepared Defences' dested Prepared Defenses; 'J'Quile' dested J'Quille; 'Vaders Lightsaber' dested Vader's Lightsaber; 'Boba Fett in Slave 1' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; Weapon Levitation is the Dark Cloud City interrupt.

The post says the deck was played in 'a couple of tournaments' (unnamed); the editor's note of 4/7/01 lists later revisions (Thrawn, Chammurra, Guri and a Monnok in; Dengar In Punishing One, Security Precautions, Jabba's Through With You and Blast Door Controls out), not applied to the list.
